chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 16: Li Huowang Finds the Vase-Girl & the Fake Scripture
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang sneaks into Danyangzi's chamber and finds a horrific secret: a talking head in a vase has been reading a fake 'Heavenly Scripture' to the illiterate alchemist. His response is brutal.
og_title: The Heavenly Scripture Was a Lie: Chapter 16 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
og_description: Li Huowang manipulates Zheng Kun into becoming his scout, infiltrates the alchemist's lair, and discovers a mutilated vase-girl who has been fooling Danyangzi for years.
twitter_title: Don't Trust the Talking Head in the Vase
twitter_description: Li Huowang's scheme pays off, but the truth he finds in Danyangzi's room is far stranger—and more tragic—than he expected.
